title: [Chapitre] VII. Analysis situs (troisième mouture) : notes manuscrites (23-26/06/1986).

errors: Lemma A (iv) is written omb_Λ(X°); it should be omb_Λ(X)°, the interior shadow.
In the Corollary, X̃^Y is defined as {X' ∈ X̃ | Z ≪ X'}; Z is a slip for Y. The defined set also reuses the bound variable name X'.

Lemma A's equivalence (iii)⇒(iv) needs omb_Λ(X)° ≠ ∅, i.e. the density axiom MΛ2. (iv)⇒(i) is a genuine separation property that holds in ateliers (pp.25-28) but must be secured axiomatically. This is exactly what p.41 does with MA5, so on this page it is only 'recalled', not proved from the axioms.
Corollary (iv)⇔(v), 'minimal implies least', requires uniqueness of minimal elements of X̃^Y. This follows from (iii) together with Lemma A, but is not argued here.
MA4 is partially crossed out and its hypothesis (the parenthetical 'supposons … = ∅') is incomplete. As written, the axiom is not well-formed.

ideas.what: Shadow (omb_Λ) of a lieu on a dense subset, and its interior part, used to detect the order and the subordination relation
ideas.modern_name: Representation of a poset or space by a dense basis; Stone/locale-style reconstruction from a basis; 'way-below'-like relation
ideas.usually_credited_to: Stone duality (Stone 1936), locale theory (Ehresmann, Isbell); continuous lattices (Scott 1972)
ideas.where_published: Unpublished 1986 Analysis situs notes (cote 156); the tame-topology programme is sketched in Esquisse d'un programme §5-6 but without this formalism

ideas.what: Lemmas A, B, C and Corollary: within a compatible region, order equals subordination, which is detected by shadows; minimal subordinating lieux are unique
ideas.modern_name: Separation/rigidity lemmas for a stratified-poset-like structure
ideas.where_published: Internal to the manuscript (pp.25-28 and here)

ideas.what: Abstract compatibility relation ≭ (reflexive, symmetric, downward hereditary) and ligature X ∥ Y = compatible but with no common sub-lieu
ideas.modern_name: Coherence/compatibility relation (cf. coherence spaces, Čech nerve compatibility); adjacency of strata

ideas.what: Axiomatic characterization of when (M, ≤, ≪, ≭, Λ) comes from an atelier ('axioms of disjunction', density)
ideas.modern_name: Combinatorial axiomatics of tame topology / stratified spaces
ideas.usually_credited_to: Not done in this form; tame topology later developed via o-minimality (van den Dries et al.)

missed.claim: An abstract, order-theoretic axiomatization of 'ateliers' via a dense subset Λ and shadows omb_Λ, aimed at a representation theorem. This is part of Grothendieck's unpublished 1986 combinatorial approach to analysis situs. The axiom list (MA0', MA4 half-struck, MA5 on the next page) is visibly still in flux.
missed.quote: Nous faisons maintenant intervenir ≭, et allons voir quelles propriétés de ≭ font marcher nos raisonnements précédents
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: A completed version would give a purely combinatorial, point-free foundation for tame/stratified topology, complementary to o-minimal and exit-path approaches. It does not appear to have been reconstructed in the literature.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is mostly a restatement of earlier lemmas in 'shadow' language plus a first, half-crossed-out attempt at axioms for the compatibility and ligature relations. The framework is unpublished and of historical interest, but the page contains no finished, striking result.
transcription_corrections: Throughout, 'omb_∧' should read omb_Λ (subscript Λ, the dense subset).
Lemma C header: 'Soit Y ≪ X, X' ≤ X'. The image shows X' written under X with a vertical ≤ sign.
Lemma A (iv) in the image reads omb_Λ(X°) ∩ omb_Λ(Y) ≠ ∅, a slip for omb_Λ(X)°.
The Corollary set is written {X' ∈ X̃ | Z ≪ X'} in the image, presumably intended as Y.
Left margin next to MA0'/MA4: 'axiomes traitant pour ≭' and 'Axiomes de disjonction'.
MA4: the first part is struck through with diagonal strokes, and 'Y' ≪ Y' is written with Y placed below; the parenthetical '(Supposons … = ∅ …' is struck. The reading is uncertain.
